definition: Determining a person’s identity from visual or biometric cues — encompassing face recognition and re-identification.
details: Determining a person’s identity from visual or biometric cues — encompassing face recognition and re-identification.

explainer.lead: Person identification is determining a person's identity from visual or biometric cues, encompassing face recognition and re-identification. It matters because it underlies systems that must know who someone is.

tiers.eli5: It is a computer figuring out who someone is from how they look or from body-based clues like a face.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers apply it across face recognition and re-identification pipelines to attach an identity to visual or biometric observations.
tiers.paperLevel: Determining a person's identity from visual or biometric cues; it encompasses face recognition and re-identification.

explainer.example: A system matches a face in a camera image against known identities to determine who the person is.
